items.title: SWE-Adept: An LLM-Based Agentic Framework for Deep Codebase Analysis and Structured Issue Resolution
items.title_zh: SWE-Adept：面向深度代码库分析与结构化问题解决的 LLM 智能体框架
items.summary: SWE-Adept is a two-agent framework in which a localization agent finds issue-relevant code via agent-directed depth-first search over dependencies, and a resolution agent implements fixes with adaptive planning and Git-based tools. A shared working memory stores code-state checkpoints indexed by execution step, enabling branching and reverting; on SWE-Bench Lite and SWE-Bench Pro it improves end-to-end resolve rate by up to 4.3%.

items.title: DeepResearch-9K: A Challenging Benchmark Dataset of Deep-Research Agent
items.title_zh: DeepResearch-9K：面向深度研究智能体的高难度基准数据集
items.summary: DeepResearch-9K is a 9,000-question deep-research dataset with three difficulty levels, search trajectories and reasoning chains from Tongyi-DeepResearch-30B-A3B, and verifiable answers, built from open-source multi-hop QA data through a low-cost autonomous pipeline. The authors also release DeepResearch-R1, an open training framework supporting multi-turn web interaction, multiple RL approaches and rule-based or LLM-judge rewards, and report state-of-the-art results for agents trained with it.

items.title: TARSE: Test-Time Adaptation via Retrieval of Skills and Experience for Reasoning Agents
items.title_zh: TARSE：面向推理智能体的技能与经验检索测试时自适应
items.summary: TARSE frames clinical question answering as an agent problem with two retrievable resources: reusable skills such as guidelines and protocols, and verified reasoning trajectories from solved cases indexed by step-level transitions. At test time a step-aware retriever selects items and the model is lightly adapted to align its intermediate reasoning, yielding consistent gains over strong medical RAG and prompting-only baselines.

items.title: Unified Vision-Language Modeling via Concept Space Alignment
items.title_zh: 通过概念空间对齐实现统一视觉-语言建模
items.summary: V-SONAR extends the text-only SONAR embedding space to vision through a post-hoc alignment pipeline that maps an existing vision encoder into it, achieving competitive text-to-video retrieval. With the OMNISONAR decoder it surpasses state-of-the-art vision-language models on video captioning, and the resulting V-LCM matches them on captioning and QA while outperforming them in 61 of 62 tested languages.

items.title: Demystifying Group Relative Policy Optimization: Its Policy Gradient is a U-Statistic
items.title_zh: 解构组相对策略优化：其策略梯度是一个 U 统计量
items.summary: The paper shows that the GRPO policy gradient is a U-statistic, deriving its mean squared error, finite-sample error bound and asymptotic suboptimality gap. It finds GRPO asymptotically equivalent to an oracle policy gradient algorithm and derives a universal scaling law for choosing group size, with experiments supporting the theory.

items.title: I Can't Believe It's Not Robust: Catastrophic Collapse of Safety Classifiers under Embedding Drift
items.title_zh: 难以置信的不稳健：嵌入漂移下安全分类器的灾难性崩溃
items.summary: The authors find that safety classifiers trained on frozen embeddings break under small perturbations of normalized magnitude 0.02, about one degree of angular drift, with ROC-AUC falling from 85% to 50% while mean confidence drops only 14%. They report that 72% of misclassifications occur with high confidence and that instruction-tuned models show 20% worse class separability than base models.

items.title: Catalyst-Agent: Autonomous heterogeneous catalyst screening with an LLM Agent
items.title_zh: Catalyst-Agent：用 LLM 智能体自主筛选多相催化剂
items.summary: Catalyst-Agent is an MCP-server-based LLM agent that runs closed-loop heterogeneous catalyst screening by querying OPTIMADE materials databases, building slabs, computing adsorption energies with Meta FAIRchem's UMA potential in AdsorbML, evaluating descriptors and modifying near-miss candidates. It converged in 1.40-3.41 trials per successful material and proposed previously unreported CO2RR candidates including Sn3Sc, Sn3Y, Tl3La, Pb3Y and In3Y.

items.title: Egocentric Co-Pilot: Web-Native Smart-Glasses Agents for Assistive Egocentric AI
items.title_zh: 第一视角副驾驶：面向辅助式第一视角 AI 的网络原生智能眼镜智能体
items.summary: Egocentric Co-Pilot is a web-native neuro-symbolic framework for smart glasses in which an LLM orchestrates perception, reasoning and web tools, with an egocentric reasoning core combining Temporal Chain-of-Thought and Hierarchical Context Compression for long-horizon first-person video QA. Experiments on Egolife and HD-EPIC show competitive or state-of-the-art results, and a human-in-the-loop study reports higher task completion and satisfaction than leading commercial baselines.

items.title: Contextual Invertible World Models: A Neuro-Symbolic Agentic Framework for Colorectal Cancer Drug Response
items.title_zh: 情境可逆世界模型：面向结直肠癌药物反应的神经符号智能体框架
items.summary: The authors present a Contextual Invertible World Model that couples a quantitative machine-learning emulator with an LLM reasoning layer, using a curated Sanger GDSC subset of 83 samples. Through inverse reasoning and in-silico CRISPR perturbations it identifies mutant KRAS dominance over the APC/Wnt axis in 5-fluorouracil resistance and a PIK3CA paradox where repair increases chemoresistance.

items.title: phuryn/pm-skills
items.title_zh: pm-skills：覆盖产品管理全流程的智能体技能市场
items.summary: A marketplace of more than 100 agentic skills, commands and plugins covering product management work from discovery and strategy through execution, launch and growth.
